resources.string: With On (no sound at all) Android itself silences the phone. The ringer mode is not changed.
Also allow media while Bluetooth audio is connected
Media (only while Bluetooth audio is connected)
🎧 Bluetooth audio is connected: media is allowed right now
Auto release done. Your previous settings are back.
Turned off because the phone was changed from outside (%1$s). Nothing was overwritten.
Required. Without it nothing can be switched.
Needed for the “on” notification with its Release button.
Needed to detect headsets and to tell earphones from car kits.
Without it the auto release can be a few minutes late.
A profile = one combination of Ringer mode and DND. Each can be a widget button.

Long-press the home screen, then Widgets, then CorrectMode.\n- Toggle (1x1): on/off of one profile. With several profiles, each tap goes to the next one and the last tap turns it off.\n- Switch: a row of buttons, wrapping into rows when the widget is made larger. All except the one in use are greyed out.
One profile: tap to turn it on or off.
Several profiles: tap one to switch to it, tap the active one to release.
Choose the profiles for this toggle.\nWith several, each tap goes to the next one in the order below, and the tap after the last turns it off.
Choose the profiles to show in this widget.
Tap to set up this widget
No profiles yet. Create one in the app.
Show the name on the widget
Only matters for profiles that allow media while Bluetooth audio is connected. Car kits and speakers are not counted in “headsets only”.
Back to the volumes from before
Ring and notification volume are restored only when the ringer mode goes back to Ring.

Ringer mode = Ring / Vibrate / Mute.
DND = Do Not Disturb (silent mode). It limits notifications and calls.

To avoid mix-ups this app only writes Ringer mode and DND.
Profile = one combination of the two.
DND access is not allowed yet. Allow CorrectMode on the settings screen that opens.

DND is still on. On Android 15+ an app can only switch off its own DND rule, so DND turned on by you or by another mode stays on.
Profiles available: %1$d (add / edit them in the app)
Leave empty for the default name
Long-press a tab to rename it. New profiles are added to this tab.

This app uses these permissions:
- Do Not Disturb access (required)
- Notifications (the "on" notice and release button)
- Bluetooth (detecting earphones)
The permission screens follow. You can change them later in Settings (gear, top right).
Notification or Bluetooth permission is missing, so part of the profile does not work. You can allow it in Settings.
Icons (colour: see Icon / text colour below)
Saves / restores profiles (with their pictures), tab names, language and the Bluetooth setting as one JSON file. Widget placement and the current on/off state are not included.
The current profiles, tab names, language and Bluetooth setting will be replaced by the file. Continue?
Cannot import while a profile is on. Release it first.
Not a backup file of this app (%1$s).
What makes a sound with this setting
Upper row: 📞calls 💬messages 📣notification sounds 🎵music/video ⏰alarm 🔧touch sounds\nLower row: ✅sounds 📳vibrate only ✖silent 🎧only with earphones ❓to check
Vibrate briefly when switched from a widget (on = once, off = twice)
Turn on automatically at a set time

Without an end time, the auto release of the profile applies (no limit if it is ask every time). If the phone was off at the start time, it still starts after boot within 10 minutes of the start (or until the end time, if there is one).
The timer could not turn a profile on (%1$s).
From now on %1$s is used for the auto release and this question is not shown.\nYou can switch back to ask every time under Auto release in the profile editor. Continue?
A set time cannot be saved (used this once only).

All sound and vibration stop.\nAlarms do not ring either, and the volume cannot be raised.\nIf you want alarms, choose one of the items above.
Makes a profile that lets every sound through.
Vibration works when a call or message arrives.\nWith Yes, app notifications do not vibrate either.
Checked sounds are silenced.\nCalls and messages notify by vibration instead of sound.
Checked sounds are silenced.\nMuted: calls and messages make no sound and no vibration.
Choose who may notify you.\nThey notify by vibration; everyone else makes nothing.
No sound and no vibration.\nAllowed apps are chosen in the system settings (same for all profiles).
